note: The role a yarn plays in a sample (sample_yarn.yarn_role). Our wording. Proposals awaiting review.

terms.label: Main
terms.definition: The ground yarn that forms the structure.

terms.label: Plating
terms.definition: Knitted in the same loops as the main yarn, kept on one side of the fabric.

terms.label: Inlay
terms.definition: Laid into the fabric without forming loops, for example an elastic yarn.

terms.label: Contrast
terms.definition: A second yarn for a picture or stripes, knitting where the pattern asks for it.
